title: Positive-unpaired cleanup and delayed repayment on finite pair-transfer graphs
statement: For any finite directed pair-transfer graph of m disjoint C3 blocks with positive raw constants,and each fixed H,there exist eps,n0 such that A_i<=H,n=min_i(B_i-C_i)>=n0,sum_i C_i<=eps*n admit E[sigma+Jnc+Zout^2]<=Zin^2,with Z=7m+1+M-sum_i mcap(A_i). No upper majority-ratio bound.

requires: Exact source C3 channels/pair transfers,finite m/edge list and fixed positive constants. Raw parity progress and hazard comparisons must be acquired,not assumed for arbitrary weak reversibility.
Positive residuals large relative to summed minority;fixed initial head H.
provides: Actual local stop pays physical time,noncore count and all real Z^2 outputs.
assumptions: High-donor core and unexpected growth are observed as actual paid failures;all competing channels retained.
costs: Constants depend on raw graph,m,H and may be poor;bounded success chance plus delayed genuine deletion trials pay errors.
contract.obstruction: Negative/mixed signs and global recurrence are not provided. Separate resource-cap trace is not inward;its signed five-state witness defeats increasing-Z receivers for that stop. No practical solver claim.

evidence.quote: # An acquired joint operation on arbitrary finite pair-transfer graphs
evidence.range_scope: Navigation;read full original operation,raw family and remaining sign/coverage limits.

body: Version3 generalizes cleanup v2 to the stated finite graph family. Immutable v1/v2 and the separate service unit retain their scopes. Resource cap/finite inverse is a separate operation,not evidence of inward drift.

review.scope: Analytic author originals;coordinator read four notes,not an independent audit. Finite programs/results are data,not rerun. No P3 source transfer.
